note: Apollo Scout. Written by the weekly scout task, read by the admin dashboard. pending = waiting for Ziyad's ✓/✗ (stored in Firestore scout/picks); done = ids already added or skipped, never suggested again.

pending.why: A century-old Meiji-era red-brick prison (an Important Cultural Property) turned into a museum by Hoshino Resorts in April 2026. You walk the old cell blocks; part of it is now a luxury hotel. Timed tickets, ~¥3,500 for visitors from abroad.
pending.halal: Small café inside; no halal certification found, so treat it as snacks and drinks only.

pending.why: A free museum about Tokyo's sewers, inside a real water reclamation plant in Ariake. You can walk through a mock sewer pipe and try the job of a sewer worker. Odd, free and almost empty.

A life-size, 18 m, 50-ton giant robot (Gigantor) standing in a small park by Shin-Nagata Station. Built for the 15th anniversary of the 1995 earthquake, by the manga's Kobe-born creator. Free, lit up after dark.
pending.halal: No food here; Kobe's halal options are around Sannomiya.

pending.n: Rikuro's Grand Front Osaka (Riku Café fika)
pending.why: Rikuro's new flagship (opened 24 Sep 2026) bakes its famous wobbly cheesecake on site, and adds a 46-seat café with toasts you can't get at other branches. Queues are long; café seats can be booked about 2 weeks ahead.
pending.halal: Cheesecake has no meat, but no halal certification; check the ingredients (gelatin, rum) for café items.

pending.why: A halal-certified wagyu ramen shop on the 7th floor of a Kiyamachi building, a few minutes from Sanjo Station (opened May 2026). Also runs small experiences like wagyu sukiyaki hand rolls and matcha.
pending.halal: Halal certified (per TableCheck); reviewers say it's on the pricey side.

pending.why: Japan's first DJI and Hasselblad concept store (opened 31 Oct 2026), with a flight cage where you can try flying a drone, plus a Hasselblad photo gallery. 11:00–20:00.

FamilyMart's first flagship, directed by Nigo: a real 24-hour konbini with a clothing floor and fitting room, a rooftop forest, flagship-only goods and exclusive coffee. A few minutes from Kamiyacho Station.
pending.halal: Normal konbini food; Famichiki and most hot snacks aren't halal. Coffee and packaged snacks are fine to check.
